title: chromolaena stachyophylla
intro: Chromolaena stachyophylla, commonly known as the "false butterfly weed", is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena stachyophylla include treating various conditions like fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as skin and wound infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
